sentences.en: When you get on the highway, shift into fifth gear.
sentences.zh: 上高速公路后，换到五档。

sentences.en: Almost every day, people lose their lives on highway A2.
sentences.zh: 几乎每天，都有人在A2高速公路上失去生命。

sentences.en: A sinkhole has appeared in the middle of the highway.
sentences.zh: 公路中间出现了一个塌陷坑洞。

senses.zh: 公路，大路，(水陆空)直接航线或路线
